ValidationRule.description: Group departure must be after arrival, picked-up rooms cannot exceed the block.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Arrival_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Departure_Date__c)), Departure_Date__c <= Arrival_Date__c), Rooms_Picked_Up__c > Rooms_Blocked__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Departure must be after Arrival, and Rooms Picked Up cannot exceed Rooms Blocked.
